claim_boundary: observational pre-write retrieval of held-out FFN write-family exemplars; not causal support or sparse execution

available_before_lookup: carrier-before vector at the selected FFN site
forbidden_during_key_construction_and_ra: GW-4A assessment labels beyond the supplied relation
query_contract.carrier_norm_check: selected FFN carrier-before norm equals the preceding attention site's recorded carrier_norm

target_contract.candidate_universe: training rows at the exact layer and FFN site with the supplied relation and a different semantic triple
target_contract.oracle_order: descending cosine between held-out observed delta and candidate observed delta
target_contract.primary_quality: best delta cosine among retrieved candidates
target_contract.oracle_gap: oracle-best delta cosine minus retrieved-best delta cosine
target_contract.refusal_rule: no structurally eligible training exemplar is an explicit miss and remains in the 88-row denominator
target_contract.candidate_fraction_denominator: structurally eligible exact-layer, same-relation training exemplar count for that assessment row

key_arms.structure_only: the complete exact-layer, same-relation candidate universe
key_arms.raw_carrier: cosine of l2-normalized carrier-before vectors within the structural universe
key_arms.relation_centered_full: cosine after subtracting the training relation mean from normalized carrier-before vectors and renormalizing
key_arms.relation_centered_pca: training-only SVD of relation-centered normalized carrier-before vectors; project and renormalize at each frozen width
key_arms.state_only_ablation: raw carrier cosine at the exact layer without the relation mask
key_arms.matched_random: uniform candidates without replacement from the same structural universe and at the same candidate count

report_separately: candidate fraction over the eligible universe
candidate fraction over all training rows

branch_rule: open GW-4C only if at least one frozen pre-write key and candidate-count point passes every progression threshold; otherwise retire direct carrier-before exemplar indexing and move to multi-site trajectories or semantic basins
